relations.statement: For any admissible boundary state, the discrete unitarity sandwich preserves the norm.

lemmas.statement: If the scalar factor of the eight‑boundary transition amplitude is a unit in the cyclotomic field, then the corrected transition (scalar·identity) is unitary.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem corrected_transition_is_unitary_when_scalar_unit {s : Cyclo12} (hunit : IsUnit s) : IsUnit (s • (1 : Matrix (Fin 8) (Fin 8) Cyclo12)) :=
  by
    -- norm preservation follows from discrete unitarity theorem
    have hnorm := FableHilbertWalk20260819.H025.DiscreteUnitarity.discrete_unitarity_norm_preservation
    -- scalar being a unit implies the sandwich is unitary
    sorry
